title: Jennifer Holliday - So in Love
htmlContent:
Jennifer Holliday delivers a brand new single called "So in Love". The song doesn’t waste a single second to prove it’s value, with a big time sound that’s hard to turn away from, as you get engulfed by the energy of the music. It not only delivers in the production but the vocals are amazing in it’s presence with an infectious charisma to it that makes you get more invested in the writing, that shines to the fullest in the chorus.

"So in Love" is her new single on Spotify and it sets the bar high for what we can expect to see from Jennifer Holliday in the future. There is no telling how far she could take this thing, but one thing is for sure, and it is that her journey is far from over. Be sure to tune into Jennifer and her music as she will be a big time star before you know it.
